info.title: QualityCheck Automation & AI Agent API
info.description:
Complete, documented REST API for QualityCheck. Designed for AI testing agents, automated test runners, and developer integrations.

### Authentication
Authenticate using one of the following methods:
1. **API Key Header**: `X-API-Key: qc_...`
2. **Bearer Token Header**: `Authorization: Bearer qc_...` (or JWT)
3. **Query Parameter**: `?api_key=qc_...`

API keys can be generated in the **Admin Panel → Settings → API Key Management** section. Each API key is bound to a specific user name so all actions performed by an agent or script will be attributed to that user.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token containing API Key (e.g. `qc_...`) or JWT

properties.name: E2E Authentication Flow
properties.description: Verifies login, token expiration, and permission checks

description.example: Send POST request to /api/auth/login with valid credentials

success_symptom.example: Status 200, JWT token returned in JSON body

result.description: Result of step execution. Supports 'pass' / 'fail' or 'yes' / 'no' (case-insensitive).

comment.description: Optional notes, evidence, or explanation of result.
comment.example: Response time was 120ms and token was verified successfully.

fileData.description: Optional base64 encoded file content for evidence/logs/screenshots.

fileName.description: Original filename if providing base64 fileData.

configFilePath.description: URL/path of an already uploaded file (e.g. from /api/upload).

get.summary: Download API User Guide & Integration Manual
get.description: Downloads the complete API user guide and AI agent integration manual (`QualityCheck_API_User_Guide.md`). Requires a valid API key passed via `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default downloaded file) or 'json' (structured JSON object with markdown text content)

200.description: The complete markdown API user guide file or JSON object

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid API key

post.summary: Request / Download API User Guide via POST
post.description: Allows an AI agent to request the user guide using JSON body specifying `{ "say": "get_user_guide" }` or `{ "action": "get_user_guide" }`.

401.description: Unauthorized - Missing or invalid API key

post.summary: Authenticate and log on via credentials or generated API key
post.description: Authenticates a user and establishes a session. Accepts either standard username/password or a generated API key directly (`{ apiKey: "qc_..." }`). Returns a JWT token and sets authentication cookies.

200.description: Authenticated successfully, returns token and user payload

get.summary: Verify active session token
get.description: Validates the current session token or cookie. If the session was initiated with a generated key, verifies that the key is still active and has not been revoked.

401.description: Invalid token or key was revoked

post.summary: Log out and invalidate session
post.description: Terminates the user session, clears server-side records, and wipes auth cookies.

post.description: Generates a cryptographically secure API key. Can associate with an existing user or create a new user profile with the given name so all agent actions are attributed to that user.

post.summary: Record points payout for a user (Admin only)
post.description: Records an official points payment/payout in the points payment ledger.

post.summary: Generate or re-issue an API key for a user (Admin only)
post.description: Generates a cryptographically secure key for the user so they can log on. The key can later be revoked without removing the user account.

delete.summary: Revoke generated key(s) for a user without removing the user (Admin only)
delete.description: Revokes and deletes all active keys for the user. The user will no longer be able to log on with those keys. The user profile, assignments, and test history are preserved intact.

200.description: Keys revoked successfully. User account preserved.
